verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own materials describe in-product AI features that turn user data into insights and suggestions. An AI troubleshooting assistant gives natural-language, device-specific answers and insights, and Session Insights is an AI note-taker that summarizes cases, spots patterns and highlights insights. Tia is described as an AI agent that learns from support sessions to predict, prevent and fix issues. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond pricing and homepage marketing lines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
